title: Routes file
description: One service, keyed by its name: a routes file listed in plat5.yml's services.

service_name.title: service name
service_name.description: The file's one top-level key: 1–128 of `[A-Za-z0-9._-]`. A rate-limit bucket prefix and the `service` on every audit event.

url.title: url
url.description: Upstream, exactly `http://host:port` (explicit port, no path, no query), from the **gateway's** network view. `https://` is **422**: TLS upstreams aren't supported yet. Credentials in the URL, a port outside 1–65535, or any other form is **422**.

rate_limits.title: rate_limits
rate_limits.description: Named policies this service's routes may reference ([below](#rate_limit)).

timeouts.title: timeouts
timeouts.description: Upstream timeouts in ms, each 1–600000. One left out uses the gateway's `UPSTREAM_CONNECT_TIMEOUT_MS` / `UPSTREAM_READ_TIMEOUT_MS`.

route_prefix.title: route_prefix
route_prefix.description: Joined to every route `path` at apply. Not applied to `upstream`.

path.title: path
path.description: Match path. Holds one param per kind in its scope's chain, named exactly as the kind ([below](#scope-and-path)).

scope.title: scope
scope.description: Required. A kind name, or `public`. A route without `scope` is **422**, so nothing becomes public by omission.

upstream.title: upstream
upstream.description: Absolute path template. Omitted means proxy `path` unchanged, which a path with chain params can't do: slugs never reach a service.

methods.title: methods
methods.description: List form: allowed methods, with route-level `required_labels` / `rate_limit` / `audit`. Map form: per-verb config, with no route-level `required_labels`, `rate_limit` or `audit`. Do not mix them (**422**).

required_labels.title: required_labels
required_labels.description: Required on every method of a route scoped to a kind other than the sign-in kind. `[]` is allowed and means any member of the tree. Omitted or `[]` on `public` and sign-in routes; anything else there is **422**.

audit.title: audit
audit.description: Omitted: the method default. Not on `public` routes.

resolve_deleted.title: resolve_deleted
resolve_deleted.description: Default `false`. `true` lets the last node in the chain be a deleted (not purged) node. Its bindings are kept until purge and still count here, as Google Cloud keeps a deleted project's policy so it can be undeleted. For identity's restore route; see [`reference/api/internal.md`](../api/internal.md#admit). Only on routes scoped to a kind other than the sign-in kind.

required_labels.title: labels
required_labels.description: `[a-z0-9:._-]+`, max 64 chars, max 32 per route, unique. A route can't require `*`.

count_at.title: count_at
count_at.description: Optional. The kind whose node holds the bucket: the route's kind or an ancestor. Omitted: the route's own kind. A policy with `count_at` can't be used on a `public` route, and on a sign-in route only with the sign-in kind.

shared.title: shared
shared.description: Optional bool. `true`: the same bucket across services that declare the name.
